name: zt-econ-digest
description: Digest a Chinese-translated economics book into ZET Cards: the ZT digest base with the economics profile (the shared digest and link prefixes and the economic model architect), built and frozen by the workflow framework
whenToUse: Turn a Scholar Archive economics book (Chinese bilingual Markdown, digested as Chinese only) into an agent Literature tree plus Topic trees, with Idea, Event, and Model Cards (economic models at concept or formal level). Modes link, models, cards, explain, hubs, figures, and audit re-run single stages on an existing digest, as in zt-book-digest.

preflight.P1: Goal and result: the book digest of zt-book-digest.js for economics books, on the framework. Same stages, commands, and result per mode; the base's report stage builds the result.
preflight.P2: Inputs: the base's args; no own args. The profile (consts.profile) is fixed: shared-prefix.md, link-prefix.md, model-architect.md alone, no compiler supplements, no skipped forms.
preflight.P3: Units of work: as the base (groups, Model Cards, compiler jobs, link groups).
preflight.P4: Roles: as the base (manager Haiku low, architect Sonnet, organizer Opus).
preflight.P5: Stage graph: the base chain with every slot empty: the economics set adds no stage, only its profile.
preflight.P6: Modules: the base's modules; the economics module set is the profile the digest, models, and link stages read (shared-prefix.md and link-prefix.md written by prepare-book-digest.ps1; model-architect.md for economic models: setting, equilibrium, comparative statics, at concept or formal level).
preflight.P7: Checks: as the base (SELF-CHECK in every DeepSeek job, zt-check, the args stage).
preflight.P8: Failure policy, modes, checkpoints: as the base.
preflight.P9: Dry run: zt-econ-digest.sim.json (mode full through every stage). Fixture: tests/framework-harness.mjs runs all checks of workflow-harness.mjs on the built script. Pilot: one chapter with cardMax and hubTrees after a database backup.
